notes.title: GATHERINGS V2 - 8 PLAYERS MADNESS
notes.notes:
[h1]We are very happy to announce Gatherings is now in version 2.0 ! [/h1]

Since the release, we delivered quite a lote of content, with [b] 6 new minigames and maps[/b], the ability to choose your car in the related minigames, several improvements, balance etc etc...

But a feedback we often had was that our type of minigames would be funnier with more players. 
And so, we did make it possible. We had to break quite a lot of stuff and repair a bit more, as well as redo some mapping in order for it to work but here it is !


[h2]Features[/h2]

- [b]You can now play Gatherings with up to 8 players [/b]: The game will adapt to the size of your party. Some maps will be different if you're less than 5, the score limit will be different for shooter game modes. 

- [b]New way of counting scores :[/b] Previously, only the winner earned points at the end. Now the top three player will earns points. 3 for the leader, 2 for the second, 1 for the third. Incidentely the default max number of points per game is now 18.

- [b]New UI for end of rounds and games :[/b] The new UI now shows the top three players and the global ranking. Same for the end UI

- [b] Game mode dungeon improvements :[/b] The AIs on Dungeon are now bumped when you hit them, added some FX, and a different behaviour on the skull you have to loot. You can also dash on your friends to steal the loot from them

- [b]Balltrap : [/b] You now have visual indication of the score earned by shoot the different items

- [b]Cook: [/b] It is now impossible to throw trays or food items that are still valid. Added some cam shake
 
- [b]TimeAttack - Vroom[/b]: Total revamp of the map which is now way easier 

- [b]Waiting Screen[/b]: You can now kick players in the waiting screen in addition to the lobby.

- [b]Vehicle[/b]: The S-kive car is now easier to handle, while keeping some balance.

- [b]Mapping[/b]: 8 players adaptation on Moving, Loot, Inverted Loot, Quake, 

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

- [b]Loading [/b]: Default camera no longers clips through the map when loading between levels

- [b]Weapons[/b]: Added reload sounds for all weapons

- [b]Loot[/b]: Removed the ability to stack loot items

- [b]Vehicles[/b]: Make the default camera smoother.

- [b]End Game[/b]: Fixed duplication or wrong order in end game menu

- [b]Global[/b]: Fix camera going through the floor when dying.

We also disabled game mode HideNSeek which we're not happy of.

notes.title: The next update will be raising the players limit from 4 to 8 !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Since the release of Gatherings we've been listening to your feedback and have already made several updates. 

Today, we're preparing a new version whose main aim is to increase the number of players. [b]We'll be raising the limit from 4 to 8 players for more fun![/b]

Tests are currently underway, and news of this v2.0 will be coming very soon!

notes.title: UPCOMING : Gatherings 1.2.0 - Wheels update
notes.notes:
The upcoming wheels update will bring new exciting features for the best drivers of the lot.


[h2]Choose your "wheels" ![/h2]
You will now be able to choose which car you'll use at the beginning of each race modes.

Choose one of three : 
[list]
[*] The [b]Tractorini[/b], the fast supercar you already know. Good car all around but maybe a little heavy on the corners ?
[*] The [b]Fjord Blur[/b], a quick hatchback whose agility comes at the cost of its top speed
[*] The [b]S-kive Fonceur[/b], an american muscle car. As such, it will go very fast on a straight line. Other than that, it's not very good at anything. Except of course its incredible style.
[/list]

[h2]A new Timeattack map ! [/h2]

Time attack City will take you in the wide streets of an American City, while also forcing you to go through its narrow alleys.


[h2]A boost in the Race mode [/h2]

Why keep your pursuants in the mirror while you could get some more advance on them and properly show who's the fastest to all of them ?

Some boost powerup are now spread on some parts of each maps that only the best will manage to get.

[h2]What do you use to cut Pizza ?[/h2]

A new Cook map where you'll fight with your fellow friends to cook the best pizza.

[h2] Enhanced controller support [/h2]

You'll now be able to put your two feets on you desk, relax and play gatherings only with the controller.
Who drives with a keyboard anyway ??
